Name: OpenXLR
Description: Control the OpenXLR daemon: hardware DSP toggles, mix and channel faders on dials, mutes with live state on the keys.
Author: Emanuele Sparvoli

Actions.Name: Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle a hardware switch, a mix mute, a channel send mute, or an insert plugin's bypass

Actions.Name: Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Adjust a level on a dial: channel sends, mix masters, gain, headphones, crossfade, insert plugin controls
